integrity: The general upper bound is attributed. Computational checks support, but do not replace, the analytical proof. No independent scientific validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Real degree-two harmonics on the round unit two-sphere only; no all-degree or complex nodal claim. The 4π upper bound was known from Gichev; the proposed new finding is the sharp lower inequality and equality classification. Independent priority and proof audit not performed.
title: Sharp nodal-length minimum for real quadratic spherical harmonics
